name: Trendex - Connect with stars
long_description:
Trendex is the world leader in digital solutions for fans in the football ecosystem.
We partnered with Zinedine Zidane, Karim Benzema, Luis Suarez, Luka Modric, Blaise Matuidi and many other ballon d'or winners and superstars (1B+ followers on Instagram totalized).
Recently, we opened NBA, F1 and Hollywood partnerships including names like Jean Claude Van Damme, Rudy Gobert (3x NBA All-Stars), Marcus Smart (Lakers) and many others.
We build digital experiences for fans and organize exclusive events for our most selected partners.
one_liner: Bringing fans closer to the world’s greatest athletes

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Tech x Sports. I have been working with top football players for years, building technology around their talent, audience, & ideas.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Jean-Joseph has extensive experience in legal and consulting. He managed operations for large and mid-size business across Europe helping them scale while maintaining them focused, goal oriented and disciplined.
